name: ecorione
description: Lapisan memori dan optimizer bersama untuk AI lokal maupun hosted

scripts.build: tsc --build && pnpm --filter @ecorione/context run copy:runtime-assets && pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run build
scripts.build:runtime-deps: tsc --build packages/shared-schema packages/shared-telemetry packages/context-assembly packages/shared-server packages/shared-ui
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:runtime-deps && concurrently -n rnd,context,connect,hub,ai -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green,blue "pnpm --filter @ecorione/rnd run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/context run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/hub run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run dev"
scripts.dev:phase2: pnpm run build:runtime-deps && concurrently -n rnd,context,connect,hub,mcp,sync,ai "pnpm --filter @ecorione/rnd run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/context run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/hub run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run mcp:http" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/sync run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run dev"
scripts.dev:phase3: pnpm run build:runtime-deps && concurrently -n rnd,context,connect,hub,artifact,sandbox,space,ai "pnpm --filter @ecorione/rnd run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/context run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/hub run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/artifact run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/sandbox run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/space run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run dev"
scripts.dev:phase4: pnpm run build:runtime-deps && concurrently -n rnd,context,connect,hub,artifact,sandbox,space,flow,flow-worker,ai "pnpm --filter @ecorione/rnd run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/context run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/hub run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/artifact run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/sandbox run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/space run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/flow run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/flow run dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --verbose && pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.acceptance:release: node scripts/release-security-acceptance.mjs && vitest run packages/shared-server/src/server.test.ts packages/shared-server/src/backup.test.ts services/connect/src/runtime-settings.test.ts services/connect/src/control-http.test.ts services/connect/src/backup.test.ts services/context/src/backup.test.ts services/rnd/src/backup.test.ts services/sandbox/src/executor.test.ts apps/ai/lib/proxy.test.ts apps/ai/lib/settings-proxy.test.ts apps/ai/lib/space-proxy.test.ts apps/ai/lib/flow-proxy.test.ts apps/ai/app/api/ops/route.test.ts apps/ai/app/api/voice/stream/route.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run secret-scan && pnpm run build
scripts.evidence:backup-restore:inventory: pnpm run build:runtime-deps && node scripts/local-backup-restore-evidence.mjs --phase inventory
scripts.evidence:observability:inventory: pnpm run build:runtime-deps && node scripts/local-observability-evidence.mjs --phase inventory
